exam_scheme.note: The Common University Entrance Test for Postgraduates (CUET-PG) is administered by the National Testing Agency (NTA) for admission into postgraduate programmes across 190+ central, state, deemed, and private universities in India. As per the revised examination structure introduced in 2024, each question paper comprises 75 domain-specific multiple-choice questions (the general Part A was removed to focus strictly on discipline expertise). The examination is conducted in Computer Based Test (CBT) mode across multiple shifts with a total duration of 105 minutes. Total marks are 300. Marking scheme: 4 marks for each correct response, negative marking of 1 mark for each incorrect response, and 0 marks for unattempted questions.
